hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Since edges can be traversed multiple times, any walk between connected vertices can include all edges within that connected component.

hints.title: Bitwise Invariant
hints.text: Traversing additional edges with bitwise and never increases the cost, so the minimum cost equals the bitwise and of all edges in the component.

hints.title: Component Queries
hints.text: Group vertices using disjoint set union while tracking the cumulative bitwise and for each component. If source equals target return zero; if disconnected return -1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Near-linear time with disjoint set union and cumulative bitwise tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Path search on each query re-explores graphs taking O(Q * (V + E)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V) storage for parent and bitwise component values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Realize that walks allow arbitrary edge traversals, making component-wide bitwise and optimal.
